# Everhour

Everhour is a time tracking and expense management software equipped with budgeting, forward resource planning, expense tracking, dashboards, and reports.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/everhour/.

## Actions

- **Create Client**: Create a new client in everhour.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in everhour.
- **Create Section**: Create a new section in a project.
- **Create Task**: Create a new task in a project.
- **Delete a client**: Delete a client.
- **Delete a project**: Delete a project.
- **Delete a section**: Delete a section.
- **Get Authenticated User Profile** (read-only): Retrieve profile information of the authenticated user.
- **Get Client by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific client by id.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve a specific project.
- **Get Section** (read-only): Retrieve a specific section.
- **List all projects** (read-only): List all projects.
- **List Clients** (read-only): List all clients.
- **List Expenses** (read-only): Retrieve all expenses.
- **List Invoices** (read-only): List all invoices.
- **List Sections** (read-only): List sections within a project.
- **List Tags** (read-only): List all tags.
- **List Team Members** (read-only): List all team members.
- **Start Timer**: Start a new timer for a task.
- **Update an existing project**: Update an existing project.
- **Update Client**: Update an existing client.
- **List Expense Categories** (read-only): List all expense categories.
- **List Teams** (read-only): List all teams.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List all webhooks.
